<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0961-n-repeated-element-in-size-2n-array.py</code></summary>

```python
class Solution:
    def repeatedNTimes(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        N = len(nums) // 2
        f = collections.Counter(nums)

        for k,v in f.items():
            if v == N:
                return k
```
